_comment: FROZEN for Release 1. Do not edit values without bumping the matching *_version key. Placeholders are explicitly marked null and are set in the phase named in _placeholders.

freshness_sla._units: max_staleness_hours, measured in UTC against the moment selection runs

_placeholders._comment: Empty. composite_threshold, the only entry this ever held, was set in Phase S4 -- see _decisions.composite_threshold.

_governed_by._comment: Parameters whose value changes what a stored number MEANS. Each list is guarded by the named *_version key: change any value in the list without bumping that version and config validation fails, in both pipeline/config_loader.py and web/lib/config.ts. Declared placeholders are deliberately excluded, because filling one is an expected event already tracked in _placeholders.

_version_digests._comment: sha256 of the governed values at each version, newest last. Kept as a HISTORY, not a single current value: an entry is only ever added, so a past version's meaning cannot be quietly rewritten. Regenerate with: pipeline/.venv/Scripts/python.exe pipeline/config_loader.py --digest

_decisions.composite_threshold: Frozen at 55 in Phase S4, approved by the user 2026-08-06, justified by calibration_reports.report_id 'calib-f95aa28bd0c1' (computed after this session's sic_code backfill, full-pool dilution/riskflags orchestration and model_applicable refresh -- the first calibration run over verified, not zero-filled, pool data). At 55 the sweep shows 5 candidates/week; the rate drops to 2 at 65 and 0 at 75+. Newly governed by selection_rule_version, bumped 1 -> 2 for this: composite_threshold is a selection-eligibility parameter, not a scoring parameter, so it belongs with selection_rule_version rather than strategy_version, the same separation already applied to universe_rules_version. frozen_config_lock (migration 021) additionally pins the exact whole-file config_hash this value was locked under, checked at official-candidate-generation time -- a narrower, additional guarantee on top of this version-governance mechanism.
_decisions.high_leverage_debt_ebitda: Added in F9. The F9 brief specifies the high_leverage risk flag as 'debt/EBITDA above configured threshold' but supplies no number, and no existing key carried one. 4.0x is the conventional leveraged-credit line, approved 2026-08-02. It is governed by strategy_version, so changing it now forces a version bump.
_decisions.freshness_sla: Finalised in F10 and approved 2026-08-02, replacing the first-pass budgets that had been flagged _provisional since Phase 1. prices_daily and corporate_actions move 24h -> 72h and filings 48h -> 96h, because staleness is measured from the moment selection runs and a Friday-close selection is legitimately three days old by Monday; the old budgets failed every weekend without the pipeline being unhealthy. fundamentals (720h) and symbol_master (168h) are unchanged. Now governed by strategy_version, which is why this change bumped it from 1 to 2.
_decisions.universe_retention_hysteresis_days: Added in S1. The brief specifies hysteresis ('remains eligible until it falls below retention thresholds for a defined number of consecutive trading days') but supplies no number. 20 trading days (~1 month) is chosen to match the monthly formal-membership cadence the same brief specifies -- a security cannot be formally dropped by a dip shorter than the interval between membership decisions anyway. Governed by the new universe_rules_version, separate from strategy_version because these are eligibility parameters, not scoring parameters -- conflating them would force a strategy_version bump for a universe-only change and vice versa. Not yet approved by the user; flag before Phase S calibration if a different value is wanted.
_decisions.universe_classification_confidence_min: Set to 'medium' to reuse the exact bar already established in pipeline/universe/classify.py's RANKABLE_CONFIDENCES (F2), rather than inventing a second confidence threshold with a different meaning.
_decisions.universe_price_data_max_gap_days: The brief's exclusion text ('no price data in 5 trading days') already supplies this number verbatim; recorded here so it is governed and version-checked like every other threshold, not left as a magic number in code.

_provisional._comment: Empty. Every previously provisional value has been confirmed.
